steps.note: The soured buttermilk is boiled to firm up its curd.
The curd is strained in a cloth to take off the whey.
Salt is mixed into the drained curd.
The curd is formed into small balls, strips or chunks.
The shaped curd is dried in the sun and wind, in the traditional way over a period of weeks.
